name: David Hammerstad
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Seattle, Washington

firm.name: Law Office of David Hammerstad, LLC

about: David Hammerstad has been providing high-quality criminal defense for nearly 25 years in state and federal court.

A graduate of Stanford University and a magna cum laude graduate of Georgetown University Law Center, Dave chose a career in criminal defense over life at a corporate firm because he loves the challenges of trial work and is passionate about protecting the rights and freedoms of the individual.

Dave's practice currently focuses on felony defense in state and federal court. He is admitted to practice in the State of Washington, the federal district courts in the Western District and Eastern District of Washington, and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. An experienced trial lawyer and graduate of the National Criminal Defense College, Dave has won acquittals in a variety of cases, including misdemeanor and felony assault, misdemeanor and felony domestic violence charges, sexual assault, burglary, robbery, and firearm charges. In federal court Dave's creative and compassionate advocacy has earned probationary or below-guidelines sentences in a variety of cases, to include drug, fraud, and firearm cases.
Dave is a past president of the Washington Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (WADCL), where he has served on the Board of Directors for the past nine years.
